instrument: Oak Valley Homeowners Association v. Board of County Supervisors (consolidated)
summary: Virginia Court of Appeals affirmed unanimously that three rezonings for a data center complex reported at 22-23 million square feet were void for failure to comply with public notice requirements.

source.citation: Regional reporting and law firm client publications

notes: Circuit court declared void August 2025. County reported spending approximately $1.72M before withdrawing April 15, 2026. Developer affiliate withdrew petitions July 2026. . Opinion NOT read
confidence_note: Opinion not read. Establishes nothing about notice law in any other state.
